items.title: Add decision-doc quorum detector and DONE gate
items.context: Detect changed docs/requirements/decisions/*.md against main...HEAD, read host_verdict process events, and require 3 distinct rounds with at least 2 distinct passing hosts and fresh material digest before DONE. Do not rely on prose-only evidence.
items.userSees: DONE is blocked with exact missing round/host/digest details when decision-doc quorum is absent.
excludes: Do not weaken existing review_pass gates

happy.desc: Logic test builds a story with changed docs/requirements/decisions/*.md against main...HEAD plus host_verdict process events for three distinct review rounds, at least two distinct passing hosts, and the current material digest; the DONE guard reports the decision-doc quorum as satisfied.

edge.desc: Logic test builds a story with no changed docs/requirements/decisions/*.md against main...HEAD; the quorum detector returns not-applicable and DONE is not blocked by missing host_verdict events.

adversarial.desc: CLI or guard test attempts story_advance --phase=DONE with prose-only evidence, duplicate hosts, duplicate rounds, or stale material digest; the gate blocks and names the missing or invalid round, host, and digest facts instead of accepting text evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke covers changed decision docs with three distinct runId rounds, two distinct PASS hostId values per round, and current decision-doc materialDigest; detector ok=true and DONE guard consumes it.
Smoke covers no docs/requirements/decisions/*.md change against main...HEAD; report applicable=false and ok=true, so DONE is not blocked.
Smoke covers duplicate hosts, duplicate run IDs, stale materialDigest, non-pass decisions, and prose-only review_pass events; all are ignored or invalid and cannot satisfy quorum.
TypeScript build passed after wiring evaluateDecisionDocQuorum into canFinishGuard and DONE failure formatting.

items.title: Provide CLI-visible diagnostics for the decision-doc gate
items.context: Expose the same quorum check through a readable command or story_advance failure details so operators know which round, host, or digest is missing.
items.userSees: A user can run a Lattice command and see whether the 3x2 decision-doc quorum is satisfied.

happy.desc: CLI check runs the exposed decision-doc quorum diagnostic, or captures story_advance failure details, for a story whose changed decision docs have three passing rounds, two distinct hosts, and a fresh digest; output clearly reports quorum satisfied.

edge.desc: CLI check runs the diagnostic for incomplete quorum states and verifies the output pinpoints the exact missing round count, host diversity, or digest freshness requirement without requiring source inspection.

adversarial.desc: CLI check feeds unsigned, prose-only, wrong-story, wrong-HEAD, or stale host_verdict events into the diagnostic path; output refuses a pass result and explains which events were ignored or invalid.

items.title: Cover pass and fail paths with focused tests
items.context: Add deterministic coverage for no decision-doc changes, missing verdicts, insufficient hosts, insufficient rounds, stale digest, and passing quorum.
items.userSees: The regression suite proves decision-doc quorum failures cannot silently pass DONE.

happy.desc: Focused test command passes for both a valid 3-round/2-host/fresh-digest decision-doc quorum and the no-decision-doc-change not-applicable path, proving expected DONE behavior is covered.

edge.desc: Focused tests exercise missing host_verdict events, insufficient hosts, insufficient rounds, and stale material digest with deterministic builders, and each case asserts the gate remains blocking with the expected diagnostic reason.

adversarial.desc: Regression test review verifies the suite would fail if the DONE gate accepted duplicate hosts, duplicate rounds, stale digests, or prose-only evidence as structured host_verdict quorum.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke passes valid 3-round/2-host/fresh-digest quorum and no decision-doc-change not-applicable path.
Focused smoke covers insufficient hosts, insufficient rounds via duplicate runId, and stale materialDigest as blocking states with structured diagnostics.
Focused smoke would fail if duplicate hosts, duplicate rounds, stale digests, non-pass decisions, or prose-only review_pass evidence were accepted as host_verdict quorum.
TypeScript build passed with the new detector API and smoke task.

items.title: Document process fact contract for host quorum gate
items.context: Update relevant lifecycle/process docs and registry checks so host_verdict quorum is a gate-consumed workflow fact when decision docs change.
items.userSees: Maintainers see host_verdict quorum described as a hard lifecycle gate, not advisory memory.

happy.desc: Docs check verifies story-lifecycle and lifecycle-gate receipt documentation state that changed decision docs require host_verdict quorum before DONE: three distinct rounds, at least two distinct passing hosts, and fresh material digest.

edge.desc: Logic or docs check verifies the process fact registry and verify-process-fact-contract script register the host_verdict quorum as a gate-consumed L4 workflow fact with the DONE gate consumer, while leaving runtime-only facts out of the process registry.

adversarial.desc: Docs/registry review rejects any implementation where host_verdict quorum is described only as advisory memory, prose evidence, or optional review guidance, or where the registry omits the signed/gate-consumed artifact semantics.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "3 distinct review rounds|2 distinct PASSing hosts|fresh material digest|Authority Server receipt completion|decision_doc_quorum_check|autopilot_review_submit|host_verdict" docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md docs/requirements/decisions/lifecycle-gate-receipt-consumption.md
verificationEvidence.note: Docs state changed decision docs require three distinct rounds, at least two distinct PASSing hosts per round, fresh material digest, and separate local quorum from Authority receipt completion.
Process fact verifier asserts decision_doc_quorum_check is read-only L0 and autopilot_review_submit is L4 host-verdict gate evidence consumed by the local decision-doc quorum DONE gate.

Registry and verifier reject advisory/prose-only drift by requiring host-verdict, execution-evidence, gate-evidence semantics and a DONE gate consumer while preserving the Authority no-overclaim boundary.
